oauth.wants: {client} wants to use {app} on your behalf, with your account.
oauth.unverified: That name was given by the application itself: trust where you go back to, just below.
oauth.returnTo: When you accept you will go back to {host}.
oauth.loopback: It goes back to a program on this same computer. Accept only if you have just connected one yourself.
oauth.goBack: Go back to the application that brought you here and try again.
oauth.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in a while.
oauth.error.client_missing: The application didn’t say who it is (client_id is missing).
oauth.error.client_unknown: This application is not registered here.
oauth.error.client_document_url: The application’s identifier is not a valid address.
oauth.error.client_document_https: The application’s details must be served over https.
oauth.error.client_document_ip: The application’s details can’t be at an IP address.
oauth.error.client_document_private: The application’s details are not at a public address.
oauth.error.client_document_unreachable: The application’s details couldn’t be read.
oauth.error.client_document_invalid: The application’s details are not valid.
oauth.error.client_document_mismatch: The application’s details don’t match its identifier.
oauth.error.redirect_not_registered: The return address is not registered for this application.
oauth.error.request_expired: The request has expired. Try again from the application.
errors.admin_only: Only an administrator can do this.
errors.already_subscribed: There is already a subscription. Change the plan from “Manage subscription”.
errors.app_not_found: That app is no longer connected.
errors.bad_request: The request could not be understood.
errors.bad_signature: The notification’s signature is not valid.
errors.billing_off: Payments are not available in this installation.
errors.conflict: That clashes with something that already exists.
errors.cross_site_request: This request did not come from the app itself, so it was refused. Reload the page and try again.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.grant_not_found: That grant no longer exists or was already revoked.
errors.internal: Server error. Try again in a moment.
errors.invalid_event: The notification could not be understood.
errors.invalid_json: The request could not be read.
errors.invitation_expired: That invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.invitation_invalid: That invitation isn’t valid: it was already used or withdrawn.
errors.last_admin: There must always be at least one active administrator.
errors.last_owner: A group must always keep at least one owner.
errors.member_not_found: That person is not in this group.
errors.no_customer: There is nothing to manage yet: no payment has been made.
errors.not_on_yourself: You can’t do that to your own account.
errors.organization_not_found: That group doesn’t exist, or you’re not in it.
errors.organization_role: Your role in this group doesn’t allow that.
errors.password_login_disabled: Accounts are managed by the sign-in page: use “Sign in”.
errors.passwords_managed_elsewhere: Your password is changed on the sign-in page, not here.
errors.plan_limit: Your plan ({plan_name}) allows {limit}, and you already have {current}.
errors.product_for: That product is bought for a group, not for one person (or the other way round).
errors.product_unknown: That product is not on offer.
errors.seats_full: This group has no free seats left ({seats} in its plan).
errors.session_not_found: That session is no longer open.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again later.
errors.too_many_tokens: You already have {max} tokens. Revoke one you no longer use first.
errors.unsupported_media_type: The request was not sent in a format the app understands.
errors.wrong_password: The current password is not correct.
